Public Access Plan for CafriplotsR — Taxonomy & Traits App

Context

The goal is to make the taxonomic name standardization + traits enrichment Shiny app (app_taxonomic_match / launch_taxonomic_match_app) publicly accessible without requiring users to create a personal database account.

The approach: create a dedicated read-only PostgreSQL user (cafriplots_public) whose credentials are embedded in the package. Since the user is read-only and access is restricted to a minimal set of tables, the security risk is low.

Why this is feasible

  • Both databases (plots_transects and rainbio) are already publicly accessible over the internet — no VPN or institutional access required.
  • The taxa database (rainbio) is already read-only for all users.
  • The public app only needs taxa and taxa-level traits — no plot data is exposed.
  • PostgreSQL’s CONNECTION LIMIT prevents abuse.

Tables Required

The table inventory was determined by tracing the call chain:

app_taxonomic_match
  └── mod_traits_enrichment_server
        └── query_taxa_traits()
              ├── fetch_taxa_trait_measurements()   → plots_transects
              ├── resolve_taxon_synonyms()           → rainbio
              ├── enrich_with_taxa_info()            → rainbio
              └── enrich_traits_with_measurement_features()
                    └── query_traits_measures_features(src="taxa")  → plots_transects

plots_transects database — 3 tables

Table Purpose
taxa_traits_measures Core taxa-level trait measurements (idtax, traitvalue, traitvalue_char, etc.)
traitlist Trait definitions: name, value type, units, min/max, factor levels
taxa_traits_measures_feat Measurement-level metadata features (used when include_measurement_features = TRUE)

rainbio database — 2 tables

Table Purpose
table_taxa Taxonomic backbone: exact/fuzzy name matching, synonym resolution (idtax_n, idtax_good_n, names)
table_tax_famclass Family/class lookup — used in some enrichment paths

Explicitly NOT granted (plot data stays private): data_liste_plots, data_liste_sub_plots, data_ind_measures, data_ind_measures_feat, data_individuals, data_traits_measures, and all other plot/individual tables.

Database Setup (run once by an admin)

User CafriP_public was created directly via the OVH server interface (OVH does not allow CREATE USER via SQL as there is no superuser). The R code below sets the connection limit and grants all required privileges.

R code to run (as admin)

library(DBI)
library(CafriplotsR)

# Connect as your admin user to both databases
con_main <- call.mydb()    # plots_transects
con_taxa <- call.mydb.taxa()  # rainbio

# ── Helper to run and report each statement ───────────────────────────────────
run_sql <- function(con, sql, label = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(label)) message("  -> ", label)
  tryCatch(
    { DBI::dbExecute(con, sql); message("     OK") },
    error = function(e) message("     ERROR: ", e$message)
  )
}

# ── 1. Connection limit ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# NOTE: ALTER USER requires superuser rights — not available on OVH managed PostgreSQL.
# Set the connection limit via the OVH control panel when managing the user (recommended: 20).
# run_sql(con_main,
#   'ALTER USER "CafriP_public" CONNECTION LIMIT 20',
#   "CONNECTION LIMIT 20"
# )

# ── 2. plots_transects grants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
message("\nConfiguring plots_transects...")

run_sql(con_main,
  'GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE plots_transects TO "CafriP_public"',
  "GRANT CONNECT on plots_transects"
)
run_sql(con_main,
  'GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO "CafriP_public"',
  "GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public"
)
run_sql(con_main,
  'REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA public FROM "CafriP_public"',
  "REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA public"
)
run_sql(con_main,
  'GRANT SELECT ON taxa_traits_measures TO "CafriP_public"',
  "GRANT SELECT ON taxa_traits_measures"
)
run_sql(con_main,
  'GRANT SELECT ON traitlist TO "CafriP_public"',
  "GRANT SELECT ON traitlist"
)
run_sql(con_main,
  'GRANT SELECT ON taxa_traits_measures_feat TO "CafriP_public"',
  "GRANT SELECT ON taxa_traits_measures_feat"
)

# ── 3. rainbio grants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
message("\nConfiguring rainbio...")

run_sql(con_taxa,
  'GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE rainbio TO "CafriP_public"',
  "GRANT CONNECT on rainbio"
)
run_sql(con_taxa,
  'GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO "CafriP_public"',
  "GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public"
)
run_sql(con_taxa,
  'REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA public FROM "CafriP_public"',
  "REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA public"
)
run_sql(con_taxa,
  'GRANT SELECT ON table_taxa TO "CafriP_public"',
  "GRANT SELECT ON table_taxa"
)
run_sql(con_taxa,
  'GRANT SELECT ON table_tax_famclass TO "CafriP_public"',
  "GRANT SELECT ON table_tax_famclass"
)

# ── 4. Verify ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
message("\nVerification -- grants on plots_transects:")
print(DBI::dbGetQuery(con_main,
  "SELECT table_name, privilege_type
   FROM information_schema.role_table_grants
   WHERE grantee = 'CafriP_public'
   ORDER BY table_name"
))

message("\nVerification -- grants on rainbio:")
print(DBI::dbGetQuery(con_taxa,
  "SELECT table_name, privilege_type
   FROM information_schema.role_table_grants
   WHERE grantee = 'CafriP_public'
   ORDER BY table_name"
))

message("\nVerification -- default privileges (should be empty or minimal):")
print(DBI::dbGetQuery(con_main, "SELECT * FROM pg_default_acl"))

# ── Cleanup ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_main)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_taxa)

Public credentials (intentionally embedded — read-only user)

Parameter Value
Username CafriP_public
Password CafriPublic01

Verifying grants after setup

-- Check default privileges (should return nothing or nothing broad)
SELECT * FROM pg_default_acl;

-- Confirm what CafriP_public can access
SELECT table_name, privilege_type
FROM information_schema.role_table_grants
WHERE grantee = 'CafriP_public'
ORDER BY table_name;

R Package Implementation (to be done)

1. Add public connection helpers

In R/connections_db.R (or a new R/connections_public.R), add:

#' Connect to main database as public read-only user
#' @export
call.mydb.public <- function() {
  call.mydb(
    user     = "CafriP_public",
    password = "CafriPublic01",
    host     = "your.server.address"  # to be confirmed
  )
}

#' Connect to taxa database as public read-only user
#' @export
call.mydb.taxa.public <- function() {
  call.mydb.taxa(
    user     = "CafriP_public",
    password = "CafriPublic01",
    host     = "your.server.address"  # to be confirmed
  )
}

2. Modify app_taxonomic_match() to auto-authenticate

Add a public_mode parameter:

app_taxonomic_match <- function(
  ...,
  public_mode = FALSE,   # NEW
  pool_taxa = NULL
) {
  if (public_mode) {
    pool_main <- call.mydb.public()
    pool_taxa <- call.mydb.taxa.public()
    # Skip login module, set authenticated = TRUE immediately
  }
  # ... rest of app unchanged
}

3. Add a public launcher function

#' Launch the public (no-login) taxonomic standardization app
#' @export
launch_taxonomic_match_app_public <- function(...) {
  app_taxonomic_match(..., public_mode = TRUE)
}

Publishing Context

This work is related to a planned article formally publishing the CafriplotsR package. Candidate journal: JOSS (Journal of Open Source Software) — suitable for specialized research software with a limited but defined audience.

The public taxonomy + traits app would be a key feature to highlight, demonstrating that at least part of the package is usable without a personal account.
